DOTA IS DEAD
I’ve been playing Dota since its inception—around 2013, if I’m not mistaken. The game, which once reached its peak, is now completely abandoned. AI-controlled bots have taken over matches, even in ranked play. Toxic players ruin every game; their vile behavior goes unchecked, as there are no effective filters, penalties, or functional ban systems. Hate speech runs rampant, as do racist attacks. Players routinely ignore their assigned roles in ranked matches without consequence. Yet, if your internet drops during a game, you’re sent to the "low priority" queue. If three players on your team report you for any reason, you lose your ability to communicate. The algorithms make it virtually impossible to string together multiple wins or climb the ranks based on merit. If you win three games in a row, your hidden MMR increases, and the algorithm fills your team with the worst, most toxic, and useless players—people who have already lost several games in a row—all in a pursuit of a "balance" that is never actually achieved. Dota is dead...
